bio.text: Jasjit "Jay" Gotra is an independent candidate for Rhode Island governor in 2026; he filed paperwork declaring his candidacy with the state elections board on May 8, 2026, as a Democrat.
He is the former CEO of Smart Green Solar, a solar sales company, and lives in East Greenwich. This is his first run for office.
American Bazaar reported that Gotra was born and raised in Mumbai, India, and immigrated to the United States as a teenager.
